stimulus:  Child labour is considered a matter of (a) (grace) for a nation. Wherever children are employed either it is  domestic work or factory work, either it is rickshaw pulling or working in a shop or hotel, they are (b)   (treated). Their (c) (employ) don't give them their due rights. Children work for longer period in (d)   (healthy) and (e) (favourable) condition and what is (f) (sorrow) they are not given due wages. Many children do the work of the adults and often do the (g)  (risk) and (h)  (danger) work. Strict laws should be   (i) (forced) against employing children in manual work. guide_solution: (a) disgrace; (b) maltreated/ill-treated; (c) employers; (d) unhealthy; (e) unfavourable; (f) sorrowful; (g) risky; (h) dangerous; (i) enforced; (j) encouraged.
